steps.intro: The steps every new member is given, in order. Drag to reorder. Each one ticks itself when the member does it. Steps whose extension is switched off are hidden from members and never hold anyone back.

settings.launcher_help: A ring with the member's progress beside the notifications, with the next step one tap away. Press J to open it.
settings.reward_help: Paid once, when a member finishes every step (skipped optional steps count as finished).
settings.reward_badge_help: A FoF Badges badge to award on finishing.

settings.reminders_help: An alert and an email to members still on their journey. Members can switch either off in their notification settings.
settings.reminder_days_help: Days after the journey started, separated by commas.
settings.close_after_help: An unfinished journey this old is put away and stops reminding. 0 keeps journeys open for ever.
